caseNameFull: Roosevelt Raceway, Inc., v. Monaghan, Commissioner of Harness Racing
attorneys: Samuel I. Rosenman, George Morton Levy and Max Freund for appellant., Louis J. Lejkowitz, Attorney General of New York, and Paxton Blair, Solicitor General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Harlan would note probable jurisdiction.
